feedback.correct: Momo flaps his big ears with joy! 'What a BEAUTIFUL card! Your friend is going to love it!'
feedback.retry: Try again, no rush. Every card gets more beautiful with another try.

hint_sequence: Look at the choices one more time. No rush — take as long as you need.
Momo is a LAVENDER elephant. Lavender is a soft, light purple. Which choice looks like Momo?
Momo taps the first choice with his trunk: the soft purple one. That is lavender!

interactions.prompt: Momo opens his big crayon box. Which crayon is LAVENDER — soft purple, just like Momo?
Draw a BIG heart in the middle of the card — as big as your hand!
Time for one shiny sticker! Which sticker sparkles the most?
Draw a mango at the bottom of the card for Momo — big and round! Then sign your name (or a squiggle) like a real artist.

objective: Design and decorate an original thank-you card: choose colours, draw a big heart and a mango, add a shiny sticker, and sign it.
off_screen: Finish a real thank-you card on paper with crayons or stickers, and give it to someone you are thankful for.
parent_note: Creativity: planning a made object (choose → draw → decorate → sign), colour recognition (lavender), fine-motor drawing. Momo models proud, unhurried making.

story_beats.art_note: Momo the lavender elephant lumbers up carrying a big blank card, crayons tumbling from his trunk; a mango tree sways behind him.
story_beats.text: Momo the lavender elephant lumbers up with a big blank card. 'I have a PLAN!' he trumpets. 'Today YOU are a maker — we are going to BUILD a thank-you card!'

story_beats.art_note: Momo lays out the steps on the card like a little recipe: a crayon, a heart, a star sticker, and a curly signature line.
story_beats.text: 'A thank-you card says: you are important to me,' says Momo. 'First we pick our colours… then we DRAW… then we decorate… and finally we SIGN it, like real artists!'
'Remember — there are no wrong cards here. Only YOUR card.' Momo holds up his crayons. 'Pick up your crayons. Ready… let's MAKE!'

story_beats.art_note: Momo does a happy elephant wiggle beside the finished card: a big heart, a glittery star, a round mango, and a proud squiggle signature.
story_beats.text: 'LOOK at what you made!' Momo does a happy elephant wiggle. 'You chose, you drew, you decorated, you signed. That is what makers do!'

subject: create
title: Momo Builds a Thank-You Card
transfer_question: If you made this same card for a DIFFERENT person, what would you draw on it instead?
